result.title: Tracktail: Multi-View 3D Point Tracking without Depth Input
result.summary: We introduce Tracktail, a novel architecture designed to efficiently track query points in 3D from multiple calibrated views without any depth input. Our architecture separates the task as a per-camera video encoding of features and a per-query decoder. Notably, camera cross-attention is only performed across queries in the decoder, allowing for efficient inference (7 FPS and less than 4 GB memory for 10 views and 100 query points). We further introduce a per-camera scene scale computed from camera geometry, which allows us to normalize inputs and predictions appropriately across a vast variety of dataset scales. We train on a synthetic Multi-View Kubric dataset as well as a novel Multi-View Point Odyssey benchmark dataset, which consists of synthetic renders of humans and animals across 499 frames. Tracktail achieves state-of-the-art results on the Panoptic Studio, DexYCB, and Multi-View Kubric benchmarks, outperforming methods that rely on estimated depth. Tracktail also demonstrates a strong ability to maintain accurate tracking over longer ranges compared to existing methods. Our code, data, and weights are publicly available: https://ai-hhmi.github.io/tracktail/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Tracktail：无需深度输入，从多个标定视角跟踪 3D 查询点；架构先按相机分别编码视频特征、再做逐查询解码，相机交叉注意力只在解码器内的查询之间进行，并利用相机几何计算逐相机场景尺度以归一化输入与预测，在多视图基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以查询为单位、跨帧跨视角持续更新的紧凑状态与尺度归一化，可能可供核查 LVR 中几何证据如何写入低维 latent 状态并在多视角间融合；但该工作面向跟踪而非 VLM 推理，联系需较多核查。
